title: Spectral Operadic Calculus: Norm-Analytic Functor Calculus
summary: Classical spectral theory provides powerful tools for analyzing linear operators, but does not extend naturally to nonlinear or compositional settings. In particular, there is no general way to transport spectral invariants in a functorial manner across structured categories. In earlier work, we showed that this failure is fundamental and introduced an operadic notion of spectrum that provides a canonical replacement. In this paper, we develop the analytic consequences of this construction and show that the operadic spectrum acts as a control parameter for a calculus of functors. We…
